Our Divisions

One group, three businesses. Vega's Distributors carries established consumer brands across the country, Vega's Industries manufactures Aqua Max bleach in Belize, and International Lubricants of Belize supplies oils and lubricants.

Consumer and commercial distribution

Vega's Distributors Ltd.

The parent distribution business, supplying supermarkets, wholesalers and commercial customers across Belize with established consumer brands and locally manufactured products.

Explore products

Manufacturer of Aqua Max bleach

Vega's Industries Ltd.

Vega's manufacturing division, producing Aqua Max bleach in Belize in one-litre and half-litre bottles.

  • Aqua Max · 1 litre
  • Aqua Max · 1/2 litre
Explore Vega's Industries

Oils and lubricants for vehicles, equipment, industry and marine use

International Lubricants of Belize Ltd.

ILB distributes oils and lubricants across Belize for commercial transportation, industrial and off-highway equipment, passenger vehicles and marine use.

  • Heavy-duty motor oils
  • Coolants and antifreeze
  • Greases
  • Hydraulic fluids
  • Gear lubricants
  • Transmission fluids
